selection_rule: earliest epoch with the highest training field span exact-match. If that epoch is within the last 5 of the budget, extend by 20 up to 120. Then the missing threshold in {0.5, 0.3, 0.7} with the highest validation field span exact-match, then document span exact-match. Ties keep the earlier threshold.
readout: one point head. The question-end state is the same causal state as before: it has seen the text and the question. The program reads the marked spans.
data: training texts are the existing 200. Exams are the four 24-document sets already on disk. No new documents were written. Forecast fields are not scored.
note: exam4 is the latest 24 already written. generalization, exam2, and exam3 are the earlier 24s, scored again with this head. They were not used to pick the epoch.
